scenarios.title: The Practice Squad Promotion
scenarios.text: A friend from the practice squad is promoted to the active roster.

choices.label: Celebrate with him
choices.result: You take him to dinner. He cries at the table, and so do you, a little.

choices.label: Introduce him around
choices.result: You introduce him to the veterans you know. He fits in by the end of the week.

choices.label: Text congratulations
choices.result: You text congratulations and go to sleep early.

scenarios.title: The Bad Haircut
scenarios.text: The rookies get haircuts from the veterans, whether they want them or not.

choices.label: Go first
choices.result: You volunteer to go first. It's terrible, and you wear it proudly for a month.

choices.label: Negotiate
choices.result: You negotiate a less terrible haircut in exchange for carrying the pads for a week.

choices.label: Hide
choices.result: You hide in the training room. They find you anyway.

scenarios.title: The Family Group Chat
scenarios.text: Your family group chat has become a running commentary on your career, including every miss in practice clips.

choices.label: Join the fun
choices.result: You join in and roast yourself. The chat becomes the best part of your week.

choices.label: Set a rule
choices.result: You set one rule: no football talk after nine. Everyone sleeps better.

choices.label: Mute it during the season
choices.result: You mute it until the season ends. Your mother is offended.

scenarios.title: The Fantasy Football Message
scenarios.text: A stranger messages you about his fantasy team, and he's angry that you only kicked one field goal.

choices.label: Reply with humor
choices.result: You reply that you'll try harder for his team. He becomes your biggest fan.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.result: You ignore it. There will be more.

choices.label: Block and move on
choices.result: You block him and turn off messages from strangers.

scenarios.title: Your First Credit Card Bill
scenarios.text: Your first credit card statement as a pro, and you don't remember half the charges.

choices.label: Go through every line
choices.result: You go through every line with a highlighter and cancel four subscriptions.

choices.label: Pay it and forget it
choices.result: You pay it and forget it. It happens again next month.

choices.label: Ask a veteran for help
choices.result: You ask a veteran how he manages it. He shows you an app and his worst statement ever.

scenarios.title: The Gym Membership
scenarios.text: A fancy gym offers you a free membership if you post about it.

choices.label: Take it and train
choices.result: You accept, post once and train there all offseason. The equipment is incredible.

choices.label: Stick to the club's gym
choices.result: You stick to the club's facility, where the staff knows your body.

choices.label: Bring the rookies
choices.result: You get them to include the rookie class. You all train there together.

scenarios.title: The Kicking Coach From College
scenarios.text: Your college kicking coach wants to come watch a practice.

choices.label: Say yes
choices.result: You get him a pass. He watches every kick and has notes for days.

choices.label: Send film instead
choices.result: You send him film instead. His notes are just as good.

choices.label: Not this season
choices.result: You say this season isn't a good time. He understands.

scenarios.title: The Cold-Weather City
scenarios.text: Your first winter in a cold-weather city, and the ball feels like a rock.

choices.label: Kick outside every day
choices.result: You kick outside every day, no matter the temperature. By December, you've stopped noticing.

choices.label: Ask the equipment staff
choices.result: You ask the equipment staff how they keep balls warm on the sideline. You learn tricks.

choices.label: Stay warm between kicks
choices.result: You build a warm-up routine that keeps your leg loose. It's half the battle.

scenarios.title: The Hot-Weather Road Game
scenarios.text: A road game in a city where it's ninety degrees in December.

choices.label: Hydrate like a pro
choices.result: You follow the trainer's hydration plan to the letter. You feel great all week.

choices.label: Rest in the shade
choices.result: You save every ounce of energy and stay in the shade between drills.

choices.label: Kick in the heat
choices.result: You kick in the midday heat to get used to it. You're exhausted and ready.

scenarios.title: The Long Flight
scenarios.text: A five-hour flight to a road game, and the veterans play cards the whole way.

choices.label: Watch and learn
choices.result: You watch the game and learn the veterans' stories. They teach you the rules by landing.

choices.label: Sleep
choices.result: You sleep the whole flight. You land fresh.

choices.label: Read the scouting report
choices.result: You read the scouting report twice. You know the stadium before you land.

scenarios.title: The Jersey Number
scenarios.text: You don't get the number you wore in college, and someone else wants it anyway.

choices.label: Let it go
choices.result: You pick a new number and let it go. The veteran who has your number thanks you.

choices.label: Pick a number with meaning
choices.result: You pick your birthday. It feels like yours by October.

choices.label: Make the new number famous
choices.result: You decide to make the new number mean something.

scenarios.title: The Rookie Quiz
scenarios.text: The coaches give the rookies a quiz on the club's history.

choices.label: Study for it
choices.result: You study the club's history all week and ace the quiz. The coaches are impressed.

choices.label: Study with the rookies
choices.result: You study in a group at the hotel. Everyone passes.

choices.label: Wing it
choices.result: You wing it and get half right. The veterans laugh.

scenarios.title: The Holiday Away From Home
scenarios.text: Your first holiday away from family, in a hotel near the stadium.

choices.label: Video call the family dinner
choices.result: You video call into the family dinner and sit on the table on a phone. It's silly and wonderful.

choices.label: Gather the other rookies
choices.result: You gather the other rookies who can't go home for a hotel dinner.

choices.label: Rest and watch movies
choices.result: You rest and watch movies. It's quiet, and a little sad.
